mentions.name: Reusable dotfiles framework
mentions.description: This project rebuilds the author's dotfiles from scratch using a hopefully reusable framework that they want to open source someday. It aims to make their computer feel like their own again, replacing reliance on VSCode and the automated configuration their company drops on machines.
mentions.problem: Computers stopped being fun for the author, who had come to rely on VSCode and automated company-provided configuration on their machines.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm rebuilding my dotfiles from scratch with a (hopefully) reusable framework that I want to open source some day.
